releaseNotes: Added an Explorer view that organizes changed files into a collapsible folder tree with language-aware file icons and Git status markers.
Added an optional Full view for browsing and opening every available file in the repository without leaving the review workspace.
Folders now show review progress and can mark all changed files beneath them reviewed or unreviewed in one action.
Explorer layout, expanded folders, and Full view preferences are retained for the current session.
Improved repository and comparison switching so file previews, editable content, and Explorer entries cannot leak stale state between workspaces.
Added a redesigned project README with installation instructions, product guidance, and an application preview.
